thread:
Alex (People Ops): Hey team — putting together a concise first-week + 30/60/90 checklist for managers to use with new hires starting next Monday. Posting a draft, please flag gaps or must-haves.

Maria (Eng Manager): Nice, ty. Can you include an owners column for each item? Managers need clarity on who does what.

Alex (People Ops): Yep — owners column is in. Draft agenda (high-level):
- Day 0 (pre-start): welcome email, account request, calendar invites, laptop shipping
- Day 1: HR onboarding (pay, benefits), IT handoff, manager 1:1, team intro + lunch
- Day 2: Product walkthrough, OKRs intro, security training assigned
- Day 3: Systems access, repo walkthrough, shadowing production runbook
- Day 4: Small starter task + code review pairing
- Day 5: 30/60/90 draft + expectations + feedback 1:1

Jules (IT): For accounts: we need full legal name + preferred email + home address for asset shipping. MFA + SSO setup usually completed within 24-48h of account creation.

Sam (New Hire): Quick q — when will I get access to the internal repo? I filled the form yesterday.

Jules (IT): If HR completed account creation today, expect invites by EOD tomorrow. If not, ping me and I can escalate.

Maria (Eng Manager): Add role-specific 1:1s in week 1: Tech lead (system design), Product (roadmap), QA lead (testing expectations). Also include a very small scoped onboarding ticket to merge by end of week 2.

Alex (People Ops): Adding those. Also adding checklist items we require managers to confirm during week 1:
- Access checks (git, ci, cloud console) — owner: IT
- Intro to team and mentor assigned — owner: Manager
- Goals/expectations doc shared — owner: Manager
- Compliance/security training assigned — owner: People Ops
- Workspace setup (calendar, slack channels, paas accounts) — owner: Manager/IT

Alex (People Ops): 30/60/90 template (feel free to copy/paste into Notion):
```
30-day: Learn & Observe
- Understand product, codebase, and team rituals
- Complete 2 small PRs
- Meet key stakeholders

60-day: Contribute & Own
- Take on medium-sized feature or project
- Improve an onboarding doc or infra playbook
- Present a project plan to manager

90-day: Deliver & Iterate
- Lead rollout of assigned feature or improvement
- Document outcomes and metrics
- Propose next-quarter goals
```

Maria (Eng Manager): Love that. Can we add a line about success metrics — e.g., code review turnaround, number of demos, and stakeholder satisfaction?

Alex (People Ops): Done. Also adding admin reminders: add to payroll, benefits enrollment window (14 days), security training due Day 7, submit workstation reimbursement form.

Sam (New Hire): Where do I find the expectations doc?

Alex (People Ops): I'll DM the Notion link. Also will create a checklist in Notion that managers can duplicate.

Maria (Eng Manager): One more: add a weekly 1:1 cadence in manager calendar for at least first 3 months. Helps with ramp and feedback.

Jules (IT): Heads-up: if the new hire needs GPU access, it requires a separate request — can take up to 1 week. Ping me asap.

Alex (People Ops): Good note — added GPU request as an item.

Onboard Bot: A welcome DM and #intros ping will be scheduled automatically on the new hire's first morning.

Alex (People Ops): Next steps: I'll turn this into a Notion checklist and share the link. Anyone want to own the manager-facing checklist review?

Maria (Eng Manager): I can review and add role-specific tweaks for Eng.

Jules (IT): I'll validate the IT access timeline and sample request flow.

Alex (People Ops): Thanks — I'll post the Notion link here once ready. :thumbsup:

Sam (New Hire): Thanks everyone — really helpful.

Maria (Eng Manager): :wave: welcome again!
